summary: Copper Property CTL Pass Through Trust filed an 8-K on 2026-11-06 furnishing its October 2026 monthly report (Item 7.01) and disclosing, under Item 8.01, a cash distribution of $0.087583 per trust certificate payable 2026-11-10 to holders of record 2026-11-09, with a determination date of 2026-10-31. No board recommendation or advisor is named; the release is a routine pass-through distribution. Mechanics are standard monthly certificate distributions funded from property/lease cash flow; portfolio schedules cover retail, distribution-center and landlord/tenant option properties. Watch distribution coverage versus property-sale proceeds and master-lease tenant performance.
